label: Encoding the circuit
subgoals: Write k plus one clauses per k-input AND, NAND, OR or NOR gate
Sum the clauses over all gates for the fault-free circuit

label: The ATPG miter
subgoals: Collect the gates in the fault site's transitive fan-out
Duplicate only those gates for the faulty copy
Fix the faulty site variable with a unit clause

label: Why it works well
subgoals: Add an XOR per affected output and an OR over them
Assert with a unit clause that some output differs
Read a test from a satisfying assignment or redundancy from UNSAT
